name: org.decentraland.unityfilebrowser
description: Clean-room, cross-platform native file/folder/save dialog exposing the Crosstales.FB.FileBrowser surface used by unity-explorer. Backed by the xdg-desktop-portal FileChooser (spoken over D-Bus directly, so it works inside Flatpak) with zenity/kdialog fallbacks on Linux, the Win32 common dialogs on Windows, and NSOpenPanel/NSSavePanel on macOS.
